question.description: The decision in one sentence, shown as the heading above the options (plain text; left out when it only repeats the report title). http(s) addresses become links.

context.description: Optional quiet line below the question: constraints, what the agent already checked. http(s) addresses become links.

options.description: 2 to 4 options, shown side by side in this order; every id is different. Use the same fact labels in the same order in every option so the rows line up.

id.description: Returned as the result's choice; unique within the payload (a repeated id is rejected).

name.description: Short name; also part of the primary button label.

summary.description: One or two sentences. An http(s) address in it is also shown as a link under the card.

copy.description: Optional text to copy for this option, longer than the summary. Shown under the card with a copy control.

allow_none.description: Offer "None of these": a quiet alternative that asks what is missing (note required) and returns decision request_changes with no choice. false hides it.

suggested.description: Optional id of the option the agent suggests. It is marked, never preselected.
